description_full: Chord Energy Corporation operates as an independent exploration and production company in the United States. The company engages in the acquisition, exploration, development and production of crude oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids in the Williston Basin. It sells its products to refiners, marketers, and other purchasers that have access to pipeline and rail facilities. The company was formerly known as Oasis Petroleum Inc. and changed its name to Chord Energy Corporation in July 2022. Chord Energy Corporation was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.

financial_summary: Chord Energy Corporation is a mid-cap energy business with a $7.1B market cap on $4.9B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +10% over the past three years and +20% annually across the full decade, a respectable pace for a business of this size.
Returns on capital run at 20% against a 8% cost of capital — a 12-point spread that is the clearest signature of an economic moat.
On the balance sheet, leverage is comfortably conservative at 0.8× net debt/EBITDA, and thin 2.5× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Management returns a meaningful 9.6% of market cap to owners through dividends and buybacks, a strong signal of disciplined capital allocation, and insider ownership is negligible, so management has little personal stake in the long-term outcome, and profit capture is only 0.4× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
